art_direction: Peaceful crimson-and-black portrait, ivory kimono, subdued shrine setting.
composition_variation: SOLO PORTRAIT OF RYOMEN SUKUNA ONLY. Exactly one character, exactly one head, one torso, one pair of arms. No other people in the background, no companion, no reflection of a person. Sukuna is an adult man in his familiar TWO-ARM HUMAN FORM, short swept-back dusty rose hair, recognizable symmetric black forehead, cheek and nose markings, sharp red eyes, calm self-assured closed-mouth expression. Fully dressed in an elegant ivory-white kimono with dark collar trim and black sash. Relaxed seated head-to-knees portrait on a dark wooden veranda, alone, centered horizontally, hands tucked in sleeves. Head center at 44 percent canvas height, face at 49 percent. A soft vermilion moon behind his shoulders at 61 percent image height. Dim distant shrine roof and sparse red maple leaves near the bottom side edges. Upper 28 percent spacious near-black with faint wine-red haze, no disk or objects. Crimson rim light on ivory fabric, stately calm mood. Polished refined anime painting. Only Sukuna and the empty quiet setting. No other named or unnamed character anywhere.
